lane_c_precede_verdict: NO CLEAN PRECEDE SIGNAL at n=1 (1 A LONG vs 4 A SHORT before the LONG post; nearest pre-fire A SHORT; whole-window 8 SHORT/3 LONG). Evidence not conclusion.
ARTEFACT_CAVEAT_PINNED: resulting_post = XAU-F007-20260721 across ALL 11 rows is an ARTEFACT of a single-post day combined with the pre-registered +/-4h window - NOT a finding. '11/11 fires followed by a post' must NEVER be quoted as a result. The discriminating question is the Lane C PRECEDE test (direction-consistent fire BEFORE the post), which was NEGATIVE at n=1.
WINDOW_FITNESS_NOTE: The +/-4h symmetric window is UNFIT for a source posting ~1 campaign/day: at ~2 fires/hour it guarantees resulting_post!=none for essentially every fire, making the field non-discriminating by construction. PROPOSED (not applied - changing a pre-registered field requires operator ratification): replace with a FORWARD-ONLY, SHORTER window (fire -> next post within e.g. 60 min AND no closer opposite-direction fire) so 'precede' means something. Recorded as a design flaw in the pre-registration to be fixed BEFORE the next session, never mid-analysis.
FIRE_RATE_CONCLUSION: 11 directional-A fires / 5.5h ~= 2/hour, bidirectional, continuous, vs ONE posted campaign. Trading every A-fire ~= 24 positions/working-day both directions vs his 1. CONCLUSION (plain): the directional-A alert stream is NOT a trade-selection signal; whatever governs his selection is NOT present in the A-grade alert output.
DESIGN_FLAW: A symmetric window (+/-4h) WIDER than the source's posting interval (~1/day) cannot discriminate: at ~2 fires/hr it guarantees a match. v1 result (NEGATIVE on precede) STANDS as recorded under v1; not rescored under v2.
